A scheduled row with `started …, see worktree` is not necessarily in flight. “In-train” is derived live from `git worktree list` and `gh pr list`; the annotation is only a human/tool hint. If the named worktree has disappeared, the annotation is stale and provides no evidence that work remains active. [epoch0-main/docs/program/BOARD.md:22-35]

Grooming should retain the row and add a note identifying the stale annotation—not silently demote or delete the row. [epoch0-main/docs/program/BOARD.md:43-54]
